notes.title: New Game Judero is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41311747/1bff930460da809fe9107ac350ce410f7d979b3c.png[/img]

Judero is an action/ adventure game inspired by the rich folk history of the Scottish Borders. You play as Judero, a Celt who can establish a rapport with the nature around him. Travel with Judero through a handcrafted landscape as he discovers there is an evil at work manipulating the unguarded.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1960900/Judero/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41311747/d4e0f41bb3531b6caeacca310c8810ae8efdd8ec.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Keyboard control customization is here!
notes.content:
This was the biggest feature request, and I'm happy to say it's here. Just go into settings and change the keyboard controls to your liking. Please let me know if there's any problem with it, and I'll fix it right away.
- Talha

notes.title: Exciting updates on the way!
notes.content:
Team is very happy to see the positive response to our weird little game. Thank you for your support. As a creator, my stance is that I want to make games that no-one else would.  I think Pill Baby is a game like this.
I'm happy to accounce we have some updates planned. The game seems to be stable, we haven't received all that many bug reports. Please let us know if you're having technical trouble with the game. This type of thing is our first priority.
But we have a big exciting update planned, too. We are designing a free game mode that will let you fight hordes of parasites, with some light rouge-like mechanics. If you are a player who can't get enough of the combat and strategic gameplay elements in Pill Baby, you should be excited.
Other than that, we are listening to your feedback. We had one request to support more control schemes. We're looking into it. Keep the feedback coming. Thanks a lot for sticking around.
- Talha
